prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Adding a steep hinge penalty only when the raw upper-tier area ratio leaves a narrow dead-band around 0.5 makes the raw partition land inside the official 47-53% band so the fixed balance-repair step flips far fewer nodes, preserving the learned cut structure and lowering TNS.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-1.060 robust(mean-std)=-0.510 min_case=-0.539 seed_std=0.261 tns_mean=-0.258 all_valid=True
  C1: score=-0.156 dWNS=-18.7% dTNS=-13.8% per-seed=[-0.02 -0.16 -0.29]
  C2: score=-0.365 dWNS=-30.2% dTNS=-35.3% per-seed=[-0.08 -0.20 -0.82]
  C3: score=-0.539 dWNS=-99.5% dTNS=-26.6% per-seed=[-0.05 -0.84 -0.72]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->180, wcut 421->575, crit_cross 0.011->0.104, repair_flips 103->117, changed-vs-baseline 24.9%
  C2: cut 318->383, wcut 1007->1278, crit_cross 0.000->0.140, repair_flips 238->244, changed-vs-baseline 23.9%
  C3: cut 582->641, wcut 1955->2182, crit_cross 0.069->0.171, repair_flips 353->370, changed-vs-baseline 28.7%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: (1) No. All runs valid, but every circuit regressed (total −1.060, robust −0.510). (2) C1–C3 all worsened: cut nets rose (137→180, 318→383, 582→641), wcut rose, and crit_cross jumped sharply (0.011→0.104, 0.000→0.140, 0.069→0.171); repair_flips also increased (103→117, 238→244, 353→370), contradicting the predicted flip reduction. The hinge apparently pushed partitions away from 0.5 rather than into the dead-band, degrading cut structure and TNS. (3) Seed spread is high (std 0.261; C3 per-seed −0.05 to −0.84), not acceptable. (4) Instrument the raw area ratio distribution per seed to verify the hinge actually lands in 47–53%; if not, retune the dead-band/threshold before retesting.
